m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Eh, what do you want? Jaki's Opossum Eggs? Oh gee, let me just consult the log I keep on everything that comes in and out of Jaki's Office.
Aw shucks, I'm not seeing anything! Did she look under her desk? That's normally where she finds whatever it is she's lost.
Honestly! Am I the only one who works here? Go away and never speak to me again. Oh, wait. Actually, I may've seen something. Oof.
Now that I think about it, the old Sanitation Engineer, Tezcatlipoca - the odd fellow from Azteca - recently raised my suspicions.
I often saw him lingering around Jaki's door. I assumed he was anticipating one of her patented messes. But he was definitely watching her.
Then, he up and quit. I was too busy worrying about keeping the Arcanum clean to focus on the large satchel he was carrying.
Oh my, what a scandal. I only wish I cared! Tezcatlipoca's your thief. Look for him in Azteca. Or don't. Like I said, I don't care.
Oh hey, Wizard. Sweet Egg! I used to have a couple just like it. What? It's my Egg? Oh yeah! Where was it? And where's the other Egg?
The creepy janitor stole them? That low down dirty fiend! And one hatched? Uuuugh! Let's go kick- What? They already bonded?
Awwwwwwww, cute! All I ever wanted for these Opossums was to give them a loving home.
Honestly, I don't think I'd be the best Opossum mom anyway. I'm SUPER busy right now. You're a good person. You keep it!
Hey, Wizard, great to see you! What's going on? Oh yeah, I asked you to come. Um, you don't know why, by any chance do you? Wait! I remember now...
The Opossum Eggs I brought here all the way from home are missing! I need to find them! They're going to hatch any second now!
Mine needs to be the first face they see to form a tight bond. Ah! What if someone stole them? Do you think Fitzhume knows anything?
Yeah! Fitzhume's great at knowing things! Can you ask him if he's seen anything suspicious? I'll wait here in case the Eggs show up!
I've got to find my Opossum Eggs before they hatch! Go ask Fitzhume if he knows anything while I keep searching here!
